Umm al-Qura's interval at Makkah on 2026-04-10 with Maghrib moved 8 minutes: Isha is sunset plus 90 minutes, minus its own 4.

Method and user adjustments of 1000 minutes each at Makkah on 2026-04-10: each is within ±1440, so the input is valid, and Fajr and Isha move by 2000 minutes. Isha falls after local midnight, at 2026-04-12 05:09. Fajr falls before the day begins, at 2026-04-08 19:30.

Adjustments at their limits, -1440 and +1440 minutes, at Makkah on 2026-04-10: they move Fajr and Isha by a whole day. Isha falls after local midnight, at 2026-04-11 19:49. Fajr falls before the day begins, at 2026-04-09 04:50.

Adjustments during polar day at Tromsø on 2026-06-21: the events that don't occur stay that way. Doesn't occur: fajr (sunStaysAbove), sunrise (sunStaysAbove), sunset (sunStaysAbove), maghrib (sunStaysAbove), isha (sunStaysAbove), middleOfTheNight (sunStaysAbove), lastThirdOfTheNight (sunStaysAbove).

The Moonsighting Committee's rules with rounding up at London on 2026-06-11. Fajr's angle isn't reached (sunStaysAbove); the bound gives the time. Isha's angle isn't reached (sunStaysAbove); the bound gives the time. Moved from 2026-06-10, which is fragile under minute rounding.
